name: design-kit
description: The Claude Desktop design picker as local, own-your-files skills: /design-kit:slides (self-contained HTML deck with notes; PDF and PPTX by script), /design-kit:design (artboard canvas of 2-4 directions with editable text and knobs; PNG/PDF), /design-kit:in-codebase (the design rendered with the project's OWN components on its dev server, plus handoff-bundle intake with a token-drift table), /design-kit:system (tokens, typefaces and a component inventory extracted from the repo or a URL into design-system/), /design-kit:artifact (one self-contained HTML page in a local gallery; LAN, pages-branch or zip sharing on consent). One localhost URL under .design-kit/; nothing leaves the machine unless you say yes.

cc_design_kit_pick.title: Board pick notice (CC_DESIGN_KIT_PICK)
cc_design_kit_pick.description: Tell you and the session when a design-kit board pick is waiting: on or off. In the terminal and the desktop Code tab it shows above the prompt with a button to read it. The environment variable CC_DESIGN_KIT_PICK overrides this.

cc_design_kit_wake.title: Board pick starts a turn (CC_DESIGN_KIT_WAKE)
cc_design_kit_wake.description: Start a turn by itself when a design-kit board pick lands and the session is idle: on or off. Off, the pick waits for the button above the prompt. The environment variable CC_DESIGN_KIT_WAKE overrides this.

cc_remind.title: Reminder hooks (CC_REMIND)
cc_remind.description: Reminder hooks that add guidance to the session: on or off. The environment variable CC_REMIND overrides this. Set in the shell, the variable mutes every plugin at once, while this option mutes only this plugin.
